answer: Each identity binds one radio callsign from the garden registry, locking a 20 POA timber bond for 90 days. Each epoch the registry issues a 6-digit echo code the holder must transmit within 48 hours, logged by two relays. A second callsign from one operator costs 40 POA, a third 80 POA, doubling each time; a proven fake forfeits all bonds. For 100 fakes the bonds alone sum to 20+40+...+2^99 POA, while 100 honest operators pay 2,000 POA. Callsigns, echo logs and bonds are public, so any verifier can check each echo. Shared club stations are exempted with 30 days of distinct transmissions each.
